T7 RELAY FALLBACK PROVEN VIA IROH'S BUILT-IN test_utils (decided 2026-05-31 — CROSS-PLATFORM, runs on Windows in normal `cargo test`, NO WSL, NOT in the admin-ui fleet). Uses iroh's OWN library testing facilities behind features `test-utils` + `unstable-custom-transports` (iroh/Cargo.toml:153,164) — NOT the external linux-only `patchbay` crate. Setup: two iroh endpoints, each built with iroh::tls::CaRootsConfig::insecure_skip_verify() + an in-memory iroh::test_utils::test_transport::TestTransport (the 'direct path' stand-in) + RelayMode::Custom(iroh::test_utils::run_relay_server()'s RelayMap). Dial an EndpointAddr carrying BOTH the TestTransport addr AND the relay addr — direct (custom) wins, relay is backup (proven in iroh's own test_custom_transport_wins_over_relay). THE CUT: TestTransport has no built-in block toggle, so wrap it in a ~30-line controllable transport (extends iroh's TestTransport with an AtomicBool drop flag) that drops the direct datagrams on demand — test-harness only, NOT substrate, NOT in the real fleet. ASSERT: before the cut selected path is direct (conn.wait_ip); flip the drop flag -> is_relayed(conn)==true AND the rafka Write frame STILL ARRIVES over the relay (frame.received span, path=relay); clear the flag -> path returns to direct (wait_ip). Observed via iroh conn.paths()/path_events()/is_relayed() — NOT a relay metrics port (the sprint-16 :9090 scrape that refused connection). Golden Principle #1: iroh's own harness, not hand-rolled fault injection. Proof = cross-platform test output + Jaeger spans, NOT the admin-ui.

T8 T7-DOES-NOT-DRIVE-IrohMeshTransport (honesty gate, code): the T7 test builds its OWN iroh endpoints (insecure_skip_verify + TestTransport + RelayMap), it does NOT call IrohMeshTransport::new() — because the real transport has no ca_roots_config (rejects the self-signed test relay) and takes only RAFKA_RELAY_URL-as-string (not a RelayMap). Adding those affordances to the real transport just to test = substrate-edit-for-a-test, REJECTED per no-hacking-substrate. So T7's honest claim is 'rafka's Write frame falls back to relay and still arrives', NOT 'IrohMeshTransport falls back'. This is recorded so the proof is not overstated at merge.
